steps.label: prep
steps.run: mkdir -p "$AGENT_HOME/work/esp_main" && cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/esp_main" && cp "$AGENT_HOME/repo/packs/esp/"* . && rm -rf s pv && bash prep.sh | head -c 2500

steps.label: stills
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/esp_main" && /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b esp.blend -P esp_render.py -- stills 50 56,132,204,300,365,465,606,717,802,885,977,1087,1201,1303,1424 > st.log 2>&1; a="build_info.json esp/e2/build_info.json"; for f in s/f*.jpg; do a="$a $f esp/e2/$(basename $f)"; done; "$AGENT_HOME/node/bin/node" "$AGENT_HOME/repo/tools/push_preview.mjs" $a | tail -1

steps.label: preview
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/esp_main" && for i in $(seq 1 20); do /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b esp.blend -P esp_render.py -- preview 1 1490 50 >> pv.log 2>&1; n=$(ls pv | wc -l); echo pass $i $n; [ $n -ge 1490 ] && break; sleep 3; done

steps.label: encode
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -framerate 25 -i "$AGENT_HOME/work/esp_main/pv/f%04d.jpg" -i "$AGENT_HOME/work/esp_main/esp_prev.m4a" -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 26 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a copy -shortest -movflags +faststart "$AGENT_HOME/work/esp_main/esp_preview.mp4" && ls -l "$AGENT_HOME/work/esp_main/esp_preview.mp4"
